text: We called to make an appointment for Thursday afternoon to get dentures. The clinic is lovely. They have a sanitizing process before the doctor's appointment. The reception staff are friendly, and the doctor and assistant are very polite.

text:
The service was extremely slow. I had an appointment scheduled quickly, but the service was very slow.
It's like they scheduled multiple appointments at once, just to make me wait and waste my time.
The orthodontist is very skilled and the service is excellent. The price is reasonable; it might not be cheap, but the results are great, and you won't need a second round of treatment.

Appointment at 1:00 PM for dental checkup, x-ray for cavities, and injections. It's past 8:00 PM and the numbness still hasn't gone away. I saw a bad doctor, and my mouth is very numb, and my jaw can't open. When I can't speak, he asks me in an irritated tone...that's crazy... If you're in such a hurry, schedule an appointment for a later time. Don't rush things. How can it turn out well? And then get irritated with the customer.

I haven't had it done yet, but I just inquired about wound suturing and wisdom tooth extraction. The staff were helpful and answered well, very pleasantly and pleasantly. I haven't had it done yet, but I'm already impressed with the service. I like it a lot. Thank you very much. I highly recommend it.
The clinic is good, clean, and sterilized before treatment. The staff are polite.

I went to a pretty female dentist.
She was rougher than other places and spoke rudely.
Usually, when it hurts, the dentist will comfort you or be gentle, but she was rude.
Plus, the price is probably the most expensive in the area.
Scaling and filling 7 teeth cost 9,040 baht.

I went for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal) and the dentist recommended a filling. After the filling, I experienced tooth sensitivity. Even after repairs, the sensitivity persisted. They suggested root canal treatment, but I don't think I'll go back for that.
The doctor did a great job. The clinic was clean and the staff were lovely. ✌🏼👍🏼 …
The orthodontist is attentive and the clinic is clean.
